question:
Identify the most appropriate synonym of the following word.

Sceptical
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Sceptical"** means** having doubts or reservations about something; not easily convinced. **(संदेहपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example:** She was** sceptical** about the effectiveness of the new diet plan.
 
 
 
• **"Incredulous"** refers to a state of being unwilling or unable to believe something; showing disbelief. (अविश्वासी)
 
 
• **Example:** He gave an** incredulous** look when he heard the news of the sudden promotion.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'sceptical'** is **'incredulous'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Stoic** (संयमी): A person who can endure pain or hardship without showing their feelings or complaining.

 
 
• **Example:** Despite the harsh conditions, he remained **stoic** and focused on his mission.
 
 
 
• **Garrulous** (बातूनी): Excessively talkative, especially on trivial matters.
 
 
• **Example:** The **garrulous** old man kept us entertained with his endless stories.
 
 
 
• **Insensitive** (असंवेदनशील): Showing or feeling no concern for others' feelings.
 
 
• **Example:** His **insensitive** remarks hurt her feelings deeply.
 
 

40:Td82,

The correct answer is **Option 2)**
